'''Quarn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the military forces of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Stationed at [[Wardpost Luurdes]], he received the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] who had been freed from the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]]-controlled [[House Syrush (estate)|House Syrush]] estate on the orders of [[Elz Organa]].
